acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce with a CPU-loaded run (record command and load) or close as not reproducible.
If reproduced, make the tests deterministic (injected clock or deadline) without weakening the production deadline.
body: Reported by the V1-0958 lane on 2026-10-07 (base 8af2bf62, host load average about 27 with two Android emulators and four agent lanes): the dogfood-event deadline tests in cmd/corvint, for example TestDogfoodEventSpawnsOneBracket, fail under load and pass otherwise. Suspected, not yet reproduced in isolation; related to the deadline class in V1-0396/V1-0881 (completed).
title: Suspected flake: dogfood-event deadline tests (e.g. TestDogfoodEventSpawnsOneBracket) fail under host load
